p: sing of mercy and judgment: David considers what manner of King he would be, when God would place him in the throne, promising openly, that he would be merciful and just.
O when wilt thou come unto: Though as yet you deferred to place me in the kingly dignity, yet I will give myself to wisdom and uprightness being a private man.
the work of them that turn: He shows that magistrates do not do their duties, unless they are enemies to all vice.
slandereth his neighbour: In promising to punish these vices, which are most pernicious in them that are about Kings, he declares that he will punish all.
faithful of the land: He shows what the true use of the sword is, to punish the wicked and to maintain the good.

I will early destroy all the: Magistrates must immediately punish vice, lest it grow to further inconvenience; and if heathen magistrates are bound to do this, how much more they who have the charge of the Church of God?
